name: L_mutual weight 0.25x
required_config_changes: set w_mutual from 0.1 to 0.025; new out_dir; keep mutual_warmup/tau/height_th fixed
expected_affected_terms: all implemented mutual terms scaled equally
risk: Still preserves ground/terrain and height failure modes, only weaker.
recommended_cheap_diagnostic_run_length: 5k-10k fine-tune after warmup-equivalent or short restart; inspect B104/B6 plus easier controls

name: roof-wall only
config_only_or_code_change: code change required unless term weights are exposed first
required_config_changes: after code exposes term weights: disable terrain/horiz and height, keep roof/wall terms
required_code_changes: expose w_vert/w_slope/w_horiz/w_height or add mutual_term_mask; note no roof-wall relation currently exists
expected_affected_terms: wall verticality and roof slope only; no terrain/horiz or height
risk: May be mislabeled if treated as roof-wall relation; current terms are class priors, not adjacency.
recommended_cheap_diagnostic_run_length: 5k-10k diagnostic with B3/B123/B126 and B104 guardrails

name: remove ground/terrain term
config_only_or_code_change: code change required unless term weights are exposed first
required_config_changes: after code exposes term weights: w_horiz=0; ideally split height into roof_height and terrain_height then terrain_height=0
required_code_changes: expose term weights and split height term if removing terrain cleanly
expected_affected_terms: terrain horizontality and possibly terrain side of height relation
risk: If only w_horiz is removed, terrain height still remains active and can continue ground drift pressure.
recommended_cheap_diagnostic_run_length: 5k-10k; must include B104 and ground-sensitive B50/B6

name: class-balanced mutual
required_config_changes: new flag e.g. mutual_class_balance=true and per-class caps/eps
required_code_changes: change reduction from global mean to class-mass-normalized weighted means; add classwise scalars
risk: Can overweight noisy minority classes if no confidence gate.

name: late-start mutual
required_config_changes: increase mutual_warmup from 10000 to e.g. 15000/20000; new out_dir
required_code_changes: none for hard late start; code change only if ramp is required
risk: May reduce effect too much; no ramp means activation still abrupt.
recommended_cheap_diagnostic_run_length: short restart to 30k or fine-tune from baseline checkpoint if loader supports it; otherwise full short run not full G2

name: gated ground term
required_config_changes: new flags for ground confidence/support/height gate thresholds
required_code_changes: add optional p_terrain/confidence/height/support gate and log accepted mass; default off
expected_affected_terms: terrain horizontality and terrain height side
risk: Bad gate can hide GroundSurface failure or remove useful terrain supervision.
recommended_cheap_diagnostic_run_length: 5k-10k with B104 primary and B0/B1/B2/B8/B50 guardrails
